# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what this PR changes.

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation fix
- [ ] Translation update
- [ ] Code snippet improvement
- [ ] Teaching structure improvement
- [ ] License or repository maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is clear and beginner-friendly.
- [ ] Links use relative paths.
- [ ] Code snippets do not include real secrets.
- [ ] New code snippets include an explanation of the business rule.
- [ ] English and Chinese docs are both updated, or this PR explains why only one language changed.
- [ ] License boundaries remain clear: documentation is CC BY-SA 4.0, code snippets are MIT.

## Additional context

Add any notes for reviewers.
